name: Downloads Data-Plane & Runtime Efficiency
changes: Adds a bounded Downloads API view used by the desktop so routine live polling no longer serializes the entire Completed/Failed history; terminal tabs load deterministic 50-item chunks with Load More while global counts remain authoritative.

Moves expensive SAB provider configuration/status/warning refreshes off the foreground Downloads snapshot path and into the existing background engine worker; real stall recovery still forces fresh provider checks at the established bounded thresholds.
Adds rolling p50/p90/p95/p99 snapshot-build telemetry plus Downloads API preparation/JSON serialization timing headers for direct performance attribution.

Overlays Diagnostics provider status with authoritative SAB runtime worker/socket state so an actively transferring provider no longer appears as standby simply because the retired native provider pool is idle.
Classifies SAB's normal Direct Unpack auto-enable message as an informational engine notice instead of an engine warning.

Compacts only terminal per-article segment/error/recovery detail from the retired native downloads.json ledger while preserving job identity, paths, timing, status and statistics; non-terminal legacy jobs are never compacted.
Writes hot automation-runtime.json in compact JSON form and continues the existing 45-day target retention to reduce repeated multi-megabyte write amplification without changing its data model.

Caches Library Integrity audit results until media-library.json or media-quality-cache.json actually changes, with cache hit/miss telemetry and a post-audit signature recheck to avoid publishing stale concurrent results.

Rejects explicit SAB completed-output paths whose normalized job identity belongs to a different Automation release, including the historical Big Brother Canada context pointed at a Love Island _UNPACK_ folder; bounded SAB staging prefixes remain supported.
Clarifies TMDB unknown status as not-probed-this-runtime and exposes the last successful TMDB age instead of presenting an ambiguous unknown state.

Preserves v3.6.48 Library Integrity hardening, v3.6.47 Selected Episodes/PAR2 repair visibility, SABnzbd 5.1.2, quality-aware selection, scan progress, strict TV identity, Smart Import and Downloads continuity safeguards.
regression_guards: The established production automation identity/Library Integrity/scan/quality/Selected Episodes/PAR2 validator remains mandatory.

The supplemental production validator continues to reject the exact historical TV false-positive corpus recovered from v3.6.47 diagnostics, including Love Island companion shows and Dark Matter title collisions.
Synthetic tests require Library Integrity cache reuse only while both persisted audit inputs are unchanged and require invalidation after a library mutation.

Synthetic Smart Import output tests require a valid _UNPACK_ folder for the tracked release to resolve and a stale cross-job _UNPACK_ folder to be rejected even when SAB history.storage points to it explicitly.
Synthetic legacy-state tests require only terminal segment payloads to be compacted and require non-terminal resume data to remain intact.

Downloads source guards require scoped live/terminal API views, 50-item terminal history loading, snapshot latency percentiles, background provider-health caching and authoritative SAB provider diagnostics.

The release publisher validates every v3.6.49 application marker plus the tray fallback version before source commit, then pushes the release trigger as a separate commit referencing that exact remote-verified source SHA.
